records.revalidation_trigger: Revalidate when the league calendar or event-route structure changes.
limitations: Automatic publication covers only source-visible official events whose physical venue is independently normalized.
Current production mapping includes Širvintų hipodromas; unknown future venue labels are rejected.
Source-visible start/end times are not promoted beyond rank C.
Programmes, participants, results and wagering detail remain excluded.
records.notes: GitHub Actions revalidated the official Events API on 2026-10-10. Event 4347 exposes 2026-10-10 12:00–16:00; the official event description explicitly identifies Širvintų hipodromas. Production publishes date+venue only.
